scope: P3/P4 real-process Executor exit during paged baseline execution
fault_cut: the first daemon is sent SIGKILL after its first baseline page and Artifact are durable but before terminal completion
claims: reconcile expires the abandoned Attempt and releases its BudgetPermit
the same Work is retried by a new daemon incarnation and a distinct Attempt
the new Attempt restarts at page sequence 1 instead of mixing progress with the old Attempt
both immutable page Artifacts remain available
no Checkpoint, accepted Observation, or Job is published from the interrupted partial baseline

verification.environment: real Atoll Server, two real daemon processes, ordinary operator, Artifact File Resource, ephemeral MySQL 8.4 non-root accounts, public read-only website
